ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Permission.Bypass_Lead_Validation), NOT(ISBLANK(Phone)), OR( NOT( REGEX( Phone, "^\\+?[0-9\\s\\-\\.\\(\\)xX#]{6,30}$" ) ), CONTAINS(LOWER(Phone), "xxxx"), CONTAINS(LOWER(Phone), "0000"), CONTAINS(LOWER(Phone), "1111"), CONTAINS(LOWER(Phone), "9999"), CONTAINS(LOWER(Phone), "unknown"), CONTAINS(LOWER(Phone), "none"), CONTAINS(LOWER(Phone), "n/a"), CONTAINS(LOWER(Phone), "test"), REGEX(Phone, "^[\\s\\-\\.\\(\\)]+$") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The phone number entered is not valid or appears to be a placeholder. Please enter a real phone number. International format is preferred (e.g., +1 617 555 1234 or +44 20 7946 0958).
